final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT s.arcref) AS n FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT fundflux, n, 1.0 * n / total AS ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT step3.fundflux, step3.n, step3.ratio, step3.n - step4.avg_ratio FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step3.n > step4.avg_ratio
